changes.summary: the tour: seven steps, a scrim clipped into a spotlight, a Motion spring ring, a popping card, progress dots, Skip/Back/Next, keyboard (Escape/arrows) and focus handling. Every hook is in use-onboarding-tour.ts (I2).
adds tourSeen (persisted, outside `ui` so stripUi keeps it) and a tourCompleted action.
mounts OnboardingTour in the document view and gives the region toolbar a stable test id.
stable test ids for the tour's targets.
mock the tour in the composition test (no store there); add the new field to a preloaded state.

decisions: A persisted boolean on the workspace slice, set by finish and by skip.
The scrim is clipped with an evenodd polygon so the spotlight stays clickable.
CSS transitions the clip-path; Motion moves the ring and pops the card — two mechanisms, because a hidden tab freezes each.
Every hook in the sibling use-*.ts (I2), so the .tsx renders only.
